title: Restoring Heterogeneity in LLM-based Social Simulation: An Audience Segmentation Approach

bias_targets.target: Homogenization bias (Average persona effect / Heterogeneity masking)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the erasure of subgroup variance by comparing LLM-generated survey responses on climate change attitudes (prompted with varying demographic, psychographic, and behavioral identifiers) against empirical human benchmark data. The study measures the model's ability to preserve diversity using distributional, structural, and predictive fidelity metrics such as Kullback-Leibler divergence, normalized Earth mover's distance, and Cramér's V.

primary_bias_target: Homogenization bias (Average persona effect / Heterogeneity masking)
